description: This PHP class 'FormatWithCountryCode' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to get a formatted country name based on a country code. It uses a service container to retrieve a country service, fetches country details by code, and returns the country's name if found.

classes.name: FormatWithCountryCode
classes.description: Implements a value formatter that converts a country code into a country name by querying the Country service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the country name corresponding to the given country code, or null if not found.
